title: Newly Updated West Nashville
description:
This two bedroom house only 4 miles to downtown, comfy beds and a full kitchen.
Two split unit hvac systems. 1 in kitchen and 1 in living room
Weed smoking is illegal in Tennessee and WILL NOT be tolerated
Stays longer than 2 weeks will pay a $125 cleaning fee

The space
Nicely designed, comfy interior. The outdoor space here is unbelievable!
There is a Queen bedroom, a second bedroom with two twin beds.

Guest access
You have access to the entire house, carport lounge, massive yard and deck.

Other things to note
Travelers with pets are subject to a $50 non-refundable pet fee, per pet. 
We expect that all of our guests with pets are up to date on their flea/tick medications. We also expect guests to pick up after their pet both inside and outside the house.
Dogs are not allowed on furniture but we have provided a large dog bed.
No cats. Owner is very allergic

True service animals are expected to remain with guests at all times. This means they will never be left alone in the home.

We recognize that this property is not high-end and has a more worn look to it. That is reflected in the price of the home and insures we are able to offer housing close to downtown, in a great neighborhood that everyone can afford and bring their pups with them. That in mind, there is always dog hair somewhere.

All other structures around this property belong to individual owners. Please respect their privacy.
